rules: Stages execute in order; missing or modified predecessor artifacts block progress.
Every acceptance criterion must have at least one test case; IDs must be unique.
Tests must include positive, negative and boundary scenarios.
Only files declared in the specification may change. Symlinks, secrets and Git internals are forbidden.
Every case must map to an executed Go test in the isolated worktree.
gofmt, go vet, go test and go build must pass before PR preparation and after fixes.
Review belongs to an exact commit and tree; any change requires another review.
Release requires explicit approval of the tested SHA and a version; published releases require a merged PR.
